name: walkmycode
description: A live map of your code in the browser that Claude drives while it explains: cards light up, files open at the right lines, tours play aloud.
long_description: Say "open WalkMyCode on ~/code/my-app" and WalkMyCode maps the folder on your computer and opens its page in your browser. From then on Claude drives the page while it explains (cards light up, files open at the right lines, paths draw, tours play aloud), and the page drives Claude: Explain, Trace it, Tour, a typed question or one said out loud reach Claude as requests. Every answer runs on your own Claude plan; WalkMyCode never sees your Claude sign-in. The page server listens on 127.0.0.1 only, with a key for each launch; .env files and keys are never read or shown. Voice keys you add in the page's Settings stay in ~/.walkmycode/keys.env.

tools.name: walkmycode_open
tools.description: Map a local codebase and open WalkMyCode's page in the user's browser.

tools.name: next_request
tools.description: Wait for the next thing the user does on WalkMyCode's page: Explain, Trace it, Tour, a typed or spoken question.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: Show an answer in the page's Guide panel; its citations light up.

tools.name: narrate
tools.description: Say a short chunk out loud on the page; chunks play in order.

tools.name: focus_node
tools.description: Select a card on the map and bring it into view.

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open a file in the page's code view, scrolled to a line.

tools.name: highlight_lines
tools.description: Light up lines of a file in the page's code view.

tools.name: trace_path
tools.description: Light up the path between two cards on the map, hop by hop.

tools.name: start_tour
tools.description: Hand the page a guided tour, played aloud step by step.

tools.name: tour_step
tools.description: Jump the page's tour to a step.

tools.name: show_view
tools.description: Switch the map's view: the system, every card, or one service.

tools.name: query_map
tools.description: Look up what a card is connected to, with file:line evidence for every link.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file of the workspace with line numbers.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find lines containing some text across the workspace.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the workspace's folders and files, or the ones matching a glob.

tools.name: walkmycode_new_project
tools.description: Open the page's New project form (Laravel, Next.js, Vite + React, FastAPI, Express): WalkMyCode installs what it needs, makes it and sets it up while the user watches.
